title: Telegram enables AI agent control via bots for remote PC #telegrambots #aiautomation #remotecontrol
description: Telegram bots enabled users to control AI agents remotely via their phones by sending commands that run tasks automatically on their PCs. The setup process involves creating a bot through BotFather, obtaining an access token, and linking the bot with the AI agent on a computer by adding authorized user IDs. This integration streamlines managing AI workflows from mobile devices, making automation more accessible and flexible. The method leverages Telegram’s bot framework to bridge mobile inputs with desktop executions, enhancing productivity and user control without specialized hardware or complex interfaces. It reflects a growing trend of decentralized AI operations and remote task management, which is valuable for both individual users and businesses aiming to optimize processes.
